notes.title: The English version of "Rooftop Story" has been launched!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the English version of "Rooftop Story" has been released. Before you purchase this game, please be aware of the following content.

Q: When will the English version be launched?
A: It’s online now.

Q: How long is the game?
A: The completion time of this game is about 10 hours.

Q: What are the operation methods of the game?
A: It is recommended to use a mouse or controller, and a keyboard is required in the text input interface.

Q: If a BUG occurs in the game, how should I give feedback?
A: You can email: graywhale@qq.com, or leave a message in the community comments.

notes.title: Pre-release QA
notes.notes:
大家好，《天台物语》即将于1月19日发售，在您购买本游戏之前，以下内容请您知悉。
Q：游戏售价是多少？
A：游戏定价29元，发售首周为26.1元。

Q：发售日和准确的时间是？
A：北京时间2024年1月19日下午4点。

Q：游戏时长？
A：本游戏有天数限制，时长为一个月，通关时间在10小时左右。

Q：游戏的操作方式有哪些？
A：推荐使用鼠标或手柄，在输入文字界面需要使用到键盘。

Q：在哪里可以交流游戏？
A：可以加入QQ群：858608694
      邮箱：graywhale@qq.com

notes.title: "Rooftop Story" game page has been released!
notes.notes:
Hello!

This is Gray Whale Studios! We are happy to announce that the Rooftop Story game page is now available!
At the same time, the first demo of the game will be officially released in Steam's June New Product Festival!

"Rooftop Story" is a simulation business game that can grow crops, raise animals, and improve relationships with NPCs.
In the trial version to be released in June, you will be able to experience some planting content and social systems.
Looking forward to your feedback! The specific launch time of the trial version will be announced later!

thanks for your support!
